blocks.text: Canyon Springs Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Canyon Springs is a small board sub-area on the south slope below Burke Mountain, around Walton Avenue and the streets south of David Avenue — and the City publishes no boundary for it.
The fixed point inside the pocket is Walton Elementary at 2960 Walton Avenue, a School District No. 43 (Coquitlam) (SD43) kindergarten to Grade 5 school on Walton Avenue.
Leigh Elementary at 1230 Soball Street sits just north of David Avenue at the top of this slope, which is why David Avenue is the working north edge used for this page.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses here are the detached stock on the Walton Avenue side streets below David Avenue, under the City's small-scale residential zones.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The rule that matters most on this slope is position, because lots here sit between David Avenue above and the creek and slope lands below.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Walton Elementary is the pocket's landmark, at 2960 Walton Avenue; school traffic on Walton Avenue is part of daily life on these streets.

Library service for this side of Coquitlam is the Coquitlam Public Library City Centre branch at 1169 Pinetree Way, plus the Library Link mobile service, until the future Burke Mountain Village library opens.

The City applies integrated stormwater management to small-scale residential projects, to manage runoff and protect local creeks — a real design cost on sloped lots draining toward the creek lands below David Avenue.
David Avenue is the through-route at the top of the pocket, served by TransLink route 186 to Coquitlam Central Station.
Route 187 runs Johnson Street east of the pocket via Plateau Boulevard and Paddock Drive to Parkway Boulevard, from Coquitlam Central Station.
No SkyTrain station and no West Coast Express station is inside Canyon Springs; both are reached at Coquitlam Central Station, south-west of the pocket.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the creek layer first: any lot within 30 metres of a watercourse top of bank or ravine bank can need a Watercourse Protection Development Permit, and the guide does not set the final setback for a specific lot.
Check the Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 Part 5 flood and slope siting rules even though this pocket is upland of the mapped river floodplains.

blocks.text: Canyon Springs home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 houses sold in Canyon Springs with a median price of $1,375,000 (the middle half sold between $1,350,000 and $1,450,400), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $545 per square foot, a median year built of 1987 and a median lot of 4,097 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Canyon Springs?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in Canyon Springs. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Canyon Springs a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Canyon Springs had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Canyon Springs from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Canyon Springs over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Canyon Springs?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

Treat Walton Avenue as the centre, not a City line. The City of Coquitlam publishes no neighbourhood plan or boundary for the name Canyon Springs, so the working pocket is the house streets around Walton Elementary at 2960 Walton Avenue, south of David Avenue and below Burke Mountain. Confirm any individual listing's sub-area label against the street address itself.

faq.q: Which elementary school is in the pocket?
faq.a: Walton Elementary, at 2960 Walton Avenue, is the School District No. 43 (Coquitlam) school physically on Walton Avenue. 43 School Locator before relying on Walton or on Leigh Elementary at 1230 Soball Street.

faq.q: Can I add units to a house lot here?
faq.a: The local limits come first: subdivision minimums are 650 square metres in zones R-1 and R-3 and 465 square metres in R-2, and a creek or steep slope on or beside the lot triggers an early call to the City and may need a watercourse permit.

faq.q: How do I get to SkyTrain from here?
faq.a: By bus or car, not on foot to a station in the pocket. Route 186 runs David Avenue at the top of the slope via Pinetree Way and Pipeline Road to Coquitlam Central Station, which is served by the Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and the West Coast Express.

faq.q: What did houses in Canyon Springs sell for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Canyon Springs between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,375,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Canyon Springs?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
